C0942.title: Professional Debt Bearer Gets 3 Million Yuan: How Long Is the Sentence?
C0942.summary: The video discusses how professional debt bearers use illegal methods to fabricate identities and fraudulently obtain loans from financial institutions, with amounts reaching up to 3 million yuan. Legal analysis indicates such acts constitute loan fraud, leading to criminal prosecution and sentencing. It warns that being a professional debt bearer is not risk-free but a serious criminal offense.
